messages:
sara: Weekly MercuryFin check-in / onboarding watch. Noticed a sustained error rate increase this morning. Account error-rate 4.7% today vs 0.9% last week. Spike 2026-03-19 08:20-09:10 UTC. Need quick breakdown (5xx / timeouts / rate-limits) + top endpoints so eng can advise rollback or rate-limits.

kevin: Pulling logs now. Quick summary for the spike window: 5xx ~58%, timeouts ~30%, rate-limits ~12%. Majority of 5xx are 502/504 from model-host pool B.

jamal: MercuryFin is in the last phase of onboarding (payments flow). If this drags, renewal-risk flag gets higher; they're scheduled for a POC review next week.

ops-bot: Alerts: account=mercuryfin_77 triggered "high-error-rate" x3 and "elevated-latency" x1 between 08:15-09:05 UTC. Dashboard: https://internal.ops/d/mercuryfin_77

kevin: Top failing endpoints (last 24h):
- /v1/chat/completions -> 42% of failing requests
- /v1/embeddings -> 26%
- /v1/generate -> 18%
- /v1/async-batch -> 7%
- /v1/healthz -> 3% (noisy CI pings)

nina: Noting that MercuryFin switched to embeddings-heavy similarity checks yesterday and enabled streaming on chat, might explain the load shift.

kevin: Trace sample shows many /v1/embeddings calls hitting a specific model shard that returned 504s after 45s. Queue depths for that shard spiked x3.

jamal: They rolled an SDK change earlier (client-sdk v2.0.0) which enabled parallel requests; could be contributing. I've asked their eng contact to share the rollout notes.

kevin: Query used to generate endpoint breakdown (clickhouse):
```
SELECT path, sum(errors) as errs, sum(total) as tot
FROM account_metrics
WHERE account='mercuryfin_77' AND ts >= now() - INTERVAL 1 day
GROUP BY path
ORDER BY errs DESC
LIMIT 10
```

sara: Can we propose mitigations that are fast and reversible?

kevin: Short list: 
- Apply a per-project concurrent request cap (soft throttle) for mercuryfin_77
- Temporarily route embeddings traffic to alternate shard pool (fallback pool C)
- Increase read timeout on gateway to 60s for embeddings to reduce upstream retries (but watch tail latency)
- Suggest customer reduce embed concurrency in client config if acceptable

nina: I can push routing change + adjust shard weights. ETA ~45m to confirm reroute.

jamal: I'll message the MercuryFin engineering lead asking them to limit client parallelism and to consider rollback to client-sdk v1.9.4 if the effects persist.

kevin: I'll open an incident ticket and put a watcher on the shard. INC-2026-4450 created.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-4450 linked to alert group 7766. Pager duty notified.

kevin: Quick smoke curl I used to reproduce heavy embed load:
```
for i in 1 2 3 4 5; do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer x' \\n  -d '{"input":"long text ...","model":"embed-v2"}' &
done; wait
```

sara: Owners / action items:
- kevin -> apply soft concurrent cap + open incident (30m)
- nina -> route embeddings to pool C + post reroute metrics (45m)
- jamal -> customer comms + ask for SDK rollback or concurrency limits (15m)
- sara -> assess renewal-risk and prep slide for POC review if unresolved (tomorrow)

jamal: I'll coordinate a short call with MercuryFin if we need a live rollback. CC @sara.

kevin: Applied soft cap at 08:50 UTC, initial impact: overall error-rate down to 2.9% after 10m. Monitoring.

nina: Started routing 20% of embeddings to pool C at 09:05 UTC. Early signal: pool C handled requests with 0.4% error vs 12% on primary. Scaling pool C as precaution.

sara: Thanks team. Please post a metrics snapshot here in 1h and update the incident ticket with customer comms notes.

ops-bot: Incident status: acknowledged. Next update due in 30m.

kevin: Will do an after-action note tomorrow once we have 24h of data. For now, edges look healthier. :white_check_mark:
